title: Recent Progress in Process and Mechanical Properties of Ultrasonic-Assisted Friction Stir Welding of Aluminum Alloys: A Review
authors: Xuliang Kong, Ying Meng, Lei Wang
abstract: Aluminum alloys, as pivotal structural materials for lightweight manufacturing, have been extensively applied in cutting-edge industries such as aerospace, rail transit, and automotive engineering. However, the conventional solid-state joining technology, friction stir welding (FSW), often faces critical bottlenecks when processing ultra-high-strength aluminum alloys or dissimilar materials, including non-uniform heat input, excessive tool wear induced by high axial forces, restricted grain refinement, and a high susceptibility to welding defects like tunneling and kissing bonds. As an advanced solid-state hybrid joining technology that deeply integrates a high-frequency acoustic field with a thermal-mechanical coupled field, ultrasonic-assisted friction stir welding (UAFSW) introduces high-frequency ultrasonic vibrations during the welding process. This hybrid process significantly improves the rheological characteristics of plasticized metals, reduces mechanical loads, and refines the joint microstructure. This paper systematically reviews recent research progress in UAFSW for both similar and dissimilar aluminum alloys. Special emphasis is placed on elucidating the underlying mechanisms of microstructural reconstruction and mechanical performance enhancement driven by the acoustic volume and acoustic surface effects. Furthermore, representative process parameters and experimental data are comprehensively deconstructed, followed by an outline of key future research trends in this field.
venue: Academic Journal of Science and Technology

infographic.key_insight: Ultrasonic-assisted friction stir welding adds high-frequency vibration to FSW, improving metal flow, reducing loads, and refining weld microstructure in aluminum alloys.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The review highlights UAFSW as a practical route to join high-strength and dissimilar aluminum alloys with fewer defects and better mechanical performance.
method: Integrate ultrasonic vibration with the FSW thermal-mechanical field.
Exploit acoustic volume and surface effects to enhance plasticized metal rheology and grain refinement.
Compare process parameters and reported outcomes across similar and dissimilar aluminum alloy joints.
infographic.evidence_signal: The paper synthesizes recent experimental studies and representative process data showing improved microstructure and mechanical properties in UAFSW joints.
infographic.watch_item: Performance gains depend strongly on ultrasonic setup and welding parameters, so benefits may not transfer uniformly across alloys or joint types.

zh-Hans.title: 铝合金超声辅助搅拌摩擦焊工艺与力学性能的最新进展：综述
zh-Hans.abstract: 铝合金作为轻量化制造中的关键结构材料，已广泛应用于航空航天、轨道交通和汽车工程等前沿工业。然而，传统固相连接技术搅拌摩擦焊（FSW）在加工超高强铝合金或异种材料时，常面临若干关键瓶颈，包括热输入不均、由高轴向力引起的刀具过度磨损、晶粒细化受限，以及易出现隧道缺陷和吻合缺陷等焊接缺陷。作为一种将高频声场与热-机械耦合场深度融合的先进固相复合连接技术，超声辅助搅拌摩擦焊（UAFSW）在焊接过程中引入高频超声振动。该复合过程显著改善了塑性化金属的流变特性，降低了机械载荷，并细化了接头微观组织。本文系统综述了近年来UAFSW在同种与异种铝合金中的研究进展。重点阐述了由声致体积效应和声致表面效应驱动的微观组织重构与力学性能提升机理。此外，还对代表性工艺参数和实验数据进行了系统梳理，并展望了该领域未来的主要研究趋势。

infographic.key_insight: 超声辅助搅拌摩擦焊在FSW中引入高频振动，改善金属流动、降低载荷，并细化铝合金焊缝微观组织。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该综述强调UAFSW是一条实用路径，可用于连接高强铝合金和异种铝合金，同时减少缺陷并提升力学性能。
method: 将超声振动与FSW热-机械场耦合。
利用声致体积效应和表面效应增强塑性化金属流变性并促进晶粒细化。
比较同种与异种铝合金接头的工艺参数和已报道结果。
infographic.evidence_signal: 本文综合了近期实验研究和代表性工艺数据，表明UAFSW接头的微观组织和力学性能得到改善。
infographic.watch_item: 性能提升强烈依赖超声装置和焊接参数，因此这些优势未必能在不同合金或接头类型之间一致转移。

title: Innovative Coatings for a Greener Sky: The 2026 Strategic Roadmap for Thermal Spray and PVD Coatings
authors: Andrew Ang, Thibaut Archer, Farzam Arhami, Mettupalayam Balachander, Kantesh Balani, Dominique Billières
abstract: Abstract Decarbonizing aviation aims to reduce greenhouse gas emissions from aircraft operations, paving the way for sustainable air travel. This endeavor requires adopting advanced technologies, alternative fuels, high-performance coatings and efficient engineering solutions that minimize environmental impact while maintaining performance and safety standards. Two of the most prevalent and cost-effective methods for applying protective and functional coatings to aerospace components are thermal spray and physical vapor deposition. These techniques enhance the durability and efficiency of several components, resulting in fuel savings and an extended service life across the aviation industry. This supports the broader aim of transitioning the aviation industry to net-zero emissions and sustainable growth. This roadmap explores how these two coating techniques can promote sustainable aviation and identifies the challenges and opportunities in the aerospace sector for researchers and manufacturers of thermal spray and physical vapor deposition (PVD) coatings. It also proposes research directions to address these challenges and discusses the role of AI, which is crucial for breakthrough technologies in process optimization and integration, new coating development and coating design optimization. The roadmap is organized into 20 concise subsections, each focusing on a specific topic. Renowned specialists in each area were invited to summarize the current status of their field, discuss the challenges it faces, and offer recommendations for necessary research and development to overcome these issues. Together, these contributions vividly highlight the essential elements of the field and the challenges that lie ahead. The innovative ideas and concepts outlined in the roadmap reveal that the future path is both expansive and far-reaching.

infographic.key_insight: Thermal spray and PVD coatings are positioned as key enablers for greener aviation by improving component durability, efficiency, and service life while supporting net-zero goals.
infographic.engineering_relevance: For aerospace engineers and coating developers, the roadmap identifies high-impact research and deployment paths to reduce fuel use, extend maintenance intervals, and integrate advanced coating processes into sustainable aircraft systems.

Synthesis of current status, technical challenges, and R&D recommendations
Highlights AI-enabled process optimization, coating design, and integration

infographic.watch_item: Implementation will depend on scaling coatings without compromising aerospace qualification, reliability, or cost-effectiveness.

zh-Hans.title: 面向更绿色天空的创新涂层：热喷涂与PVD涂层的2026战略路线图
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 航空业脱碳旨在减少飞机运营产生的温室气体排放，为可持续航空旅行铺平道路。这一努力需要采用先进技术、替代燃料、高性能涂层以及高效的工程解决方案，在维持性能和安全标准的同时尽量降低环境影响。用于航空航天部件防护和功能涂层制备的两种最普遍且最具成本效益的方法是热喷涂和物理气相沉积。这些技术可提升多种部件的耐久性和效率，从而在航空业实现燃油节省并延长服役寿命。这有助于推动航空业向净零排放和可持续增长转型。该路线图探讨了这两种涂层技术如何促进可持续航空，并识别了热喷涂与物理气相沉积（PVD）涂层研究人员和制造商在航空航天领域面临的挑战与机遇。它还提出了应对这些挑战的研究方向，并讨论了AI的作用；AI对于工艺优化与集成、新型涂层开发以及涂层设计优化等突破性技术至关重要。该路线图共由20个简明子部分组成，每一部分聚焦一个特定主题。我们邀请了各领域知名专家概述其研究方向的现状，讨论所面临的挑战，并提出克服这些问题所需的研发建议。这些贡献共同生动地凸显了该领域的核心要素以及未来将面临的挑战。路线图中概述的创新思想和概念表明，未来的发展路径既广阔又深远。

infographic.key_insight: 热喷涂和PVD涂层通过提高部件耐久性、效率和服役寿命，同时支持净零目标，被定位为实现更绿色航空的关键使能技术。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 对于航空航天工程师和涂层开发人员而言，该路线图识别了高影响力的研究与部署路径，可减少燃油消耗、延长维护间隔，并将先进涂层工艺集成到可持续飞机系统中。
method: 由受邀领域专家对20个聚焦子部分进行路线图式综述
综合当前状态、技术挑战和研发建议
突出AI赋能的工艺优化、涂层设计与集成
infographic.evidence_signal: 该摘要属于观点性路线图而非实验研究，因此其证据主要来自专家共识和领域综合，而非新的定量验证。
infographic.watch_item: 其实施将取决于在不损害航空航天认证、可靠性或成本效益的前提下实现涂层规模化。

title: HVAF Spraying of NiTi Coatings: Microstructure, Phase Transformation and Shape Memory Behavior
authors: Sneha Samal, Shrikant Joshi, Stefan Björklund, Mohit Chandra, Akhil Bhardwaj, Jaromír Kopeček
abstract: Depositing various coatings on surface of engineering components with the aim to improve their performance concerning wear, corrosion, friction and thermal protection is already a standard practice. Depositing metallic NiTi shape memory alloy coatings may be a viable alternative for hard ceramic coatings. NiTi coatings offer additional benefits originating from unique functional thermomechanical properties. However, fabrication of thick NiTi coatings turned out to be difficult. Standard electroplating and laser cladding methods are not suitable for NiTi the most widely used plasma spray methods tend to produce chemically inhomogeneous coatings that do not transform martensitically, cold sprayed NiTi coatings suffer from poor adhesion to the substrates. In this work we report on first ever successful fabrication of thick NiTi coatings (100-300 um) that display functional thermomechanical properties and simultaneously show very good adherence to the substrate. We used high velocity air fuel thermal spray method to fabricate NiTi coatings deposited on mild steel using four different sets of processing parameters. Chemical composition, porosity, microstructure, phase transformation and functional thermomechanical properties of the NiTi coatings were evaluated. Although the coatings contain inhomogeneous microstructure, voids, oxide particles, high density of dislocation defects and internal stress, they undergo martensitic transformation upon cooling and or mechanical loading. As sprayed NiTi coatings need to be annealed to display functional thermomechanical properties. Despite their limited tensile strength, the coatings displayed thermal actuation in 3 point bending tests and shape memory effects in nanoindentation and scratch tests.

infographic.key_insight: HVAF spraying can produce thick NiTi coatings that retain martensitic transformation and functional shape-memory behavior, but only after heat treatment to overcome spray-induced defects and inhomogeneity.
infographic.engineering_relevance: This work shows a practical route to add smart, self-actuating NiTi surfaces on steel components for wear and thermal-function applications where conventional ceramic coatings may be less suitable.
method: HVAF-sprayed NiTi coatings onto mild steel using four parameter sets
Characterized composition, porosity, microstructure, phase transformation, and thermomechanical response
Evaluated functionality with annealing, 3-point bending, nanoindentation, and scratch tests
infographic.evidence_signal: The coatings were 100–300 µm thick and showed martensitic transformation plus thermal actuation and shape memory effects, despite high defect density and internal stress.
infographic.watch_item: As-sprayed coatings are not fully functional and need annealing; their inhomogeneous microstructure and limited tensile strength may constrain reliability in demanding service conditions.
infographic.paper_title: HVAF Spraying of NiTi Coatings: Microstructure, Phase Transformation and Shape Memory Behavior

zh-Hans.title: HVAF喷涂NiTi涂层：显微组织、相变与形状记忆行为
zh-Hans.abstract: 在工程部件表面沉积各种涂层以提高其在耐磨、耐腐蚀、减摩和热防护方面的性能，已是一项标准做法。沉积金属NiTi形状记忆合金涂层可能是硬质陶瓷涂层的一种可行替代方案。NiTi涂层可凭借独特的功能性热机械特性提供额外优势。然而，制备厚NiTi涂层已被证明较为困难。标准电镀和激光熔覆方法不适用于NiTi；最广泛使用的等离子喷涂方法往往会制备出化学成分不均匀、且不发生马氏体转变的涂层，而冷喷NiTi涂层则存在与基体结合不良的问题。在本工作中，我们报道了首次成功制备出厚NiTi涂层（100-300 um），其既表现出功能性热机械特性，同时又与基体具有很好的附着性。我们采用高速空气燃料热喷涂方法，在低碳钢上使用四组不同的工艺参数制备NiTi涂层。对NiTi涂层的化学成分、孔隙率、显微组织、相变以及功能性热机械特性进行了评估。尽管涂层包含不均匀的显微组织、空洞、氧化物颗粒、高密度位错缺陷和内应力，但它们在冷却和/或机械加载过程中仍会发生马氏体转变。喷涂态NiTi涂层需要进行退火，才能表现出功能性热机械特性。尽管其拉伸强度有限，这些涂层在三点弯曲试验中表现出热致驱动，在纳米压痕和划痕试验中表现出形状记忆效应。

infographic.key_insight: HVAF喷涂可制备厚NiTi涂层，使其保留马氏体转变和功能性形状记忆行为，但需经过热处理以克服喷涂引入的缺陷和不均匀性。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 本工作表明了一条在钢制部件上引入智能、可自驱动NiTi表面的实用途径，适用于耐磨和热功能应用，在这些场景下传统陶瓷涂层可能并不最合适。
method: 采用四组参数对低碳钢进行HVAF喷涂NiTi涂层
表征成分、孔隙率、显微组织、相变和热机械响应
通过退火、三点弯曲、纳米压痕和划痕试验评估功能性
infographic.evidence_signal: 这些涂层厚度为100–300 µm，尽管存在高缺陷密度和内应力，仍表现出马氏体转变以及热致驱动和形状记忆效应。
infographic.watch_item: 喷涂态涂层并非完全具有功能性，需要退火；其不均匀的显微组织和有限的拉伸强度可能限制其在苛刻服役条件下的可靠性。

title: INNOVATED WATER WELDING MACHINE FOR ENTREPRENEURSHIP
authors: MERLY A. MONTES, Redjie D. Arcadio
abstract: Technological innovation is a significant factor in promoting sustainable entrepreneurship, creating livelihoods, and fostering community development. This study was in accordance with the extension agenda of the Cebu Technological University “Bringing the University to the Countryside” which is the design, development and evaluation of an innovative water welding machine for the enhancement of entrepreneurship at the Cebu Technological University (CTU) Pinamungajan Campus Extension Services in the academic year 2019–2020. The innovation was based on the principles of seawater-based electrolysis and the use of locally available materials to develop an affordable, environmentally sustainable and entrepreneurially viable welding technology for rural communities. The study used the Research and Development (R&D) method with a descriptive-developmental research design. The development process included conceptualization, design, fabrication, testing, validation and evaluation of the new water welding machine. The participants were 138 respondents comprised of technical instructor, expert and industrial students. The selection of the respondents was done through purposive sampling. Functionality of the machine, acceptability based on the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) and entrepreneurial potential were assessed using a researcher developed questionnaire validated by experts. Statistical tools used were frequency counts, percentages, weighted means, standard deviations, composite means, rankings and analysis of variance (ANOVA). The results indicated that the innovated water welding machine had a very high functional rating with regard to performance (M = 4.55), efficiency (M = 4.55), safety (M = 4.56), durability (M = 4.55) and reliability (M = 4.55). Moreover, the machine was rated Very Highly Acceptable on the perceived usefulness (M = 4.56), perceived ease of use (M = 4.55), user satisfaction (M = 4.56) and behavioral intention to use (M = 4.56). Moreover, the developed innovation was rated as Very Highly Potential in terms of cost-effectiveness, income generating potential, marketability and sustainability in terms of the entrepreneurial capacity. The ANOVA results showed that there were no statistically significant differences in the respondents’ assessment grouped by profile variables (F = 1.273, p = 0.283). These findings suggest that the Innovated Water Welding Machine is functional, acceptable, sustainable and economically viable and is suitable for entrepreneurship, technology transfer and community extension programs. The study supports the Diffusion of Innovations Theory, the Technology Acceptance Model, and the Human Capital Theory in demonstrating the importance of technology adoption, skill development, and entrepreneurial empowerment. Moreover, the innovation facilitates sustainable livelihood generation, technology advancement, and the mission of higher education institutions to develop community-responsive research and extension undertakings.

infographic.key_insight: The study developed an affordable water-based welding machine using seawater electrolysis principles and found it to be highly functional, acceptable, and promising for rural entrepreneurship.
infographic.engineering_relevance: This work shows how locally available materials and simple electrochemical principles can be turned into a practical fabrication technology for low-resource communities.
method: Used a Research and Development (R&D) approach with a descriptive-developmental design.
Built the machine through conceptualization, design, fabrication, testing, validation, and evaluation.
Assessed functionality, TAM-based acceptability, and entrepreneurial potential using a validated questionnaire.
infographic.evidence_signal: Evaluation from 138 respondents showed very high ratings for performance, efficiency, safety, durability, reliability, usefulness, ease of use, satisfaction, and intention to use, with ANOVA used for comparison.
infographic.watch_item: The abstract reports positive ratings but does not provide detailed experimental welding performance data or long-term field durability results, so real-world deployment should be validated further.
infographic.paper_title: INNOVATED WATER WELDING MACHINE FOR ENTREPRENEURSHIP

zh-Hans.title: 面向创业的创新型水焊机
zh-Hans.abstract: 技术创新是促进可持续创业、创造生计和推动社区发展的重要因素。本研究符合宿务理工大学“把大学带到乡村”推广议程，围绕 2019–2020 学年在 Cebu Technological University (CTU) Pinamungajan 校区扩展服务中用于提升创业能力的创新型水焊机的设计、开发与评估展开。该创新基于以海水为基础的电解原理，并利用本地可获得材料，开发一种面向农村社区、价格可承受、环境可持续且具有创业可行性的焊接技术。本研究采用研究与开发（R&D）方法，研究设计为描述性开发研究。开发过程包括新型水焊机的概念化、设计、制造、测试、验证和评估。参与者共 138 名，由技术讲师、专家和工业类学生组成。受访者通过目的抽样选取。研究采用经专家验证的自编问卷，对机器功能性、基于技术接受模型（TAM）的可接受性以及创业潜力进行评估。使用的统计工具包括频数、百分比、加权平均数、标准差、综合平均数、排序以及方差分析（ANOVA）。结果表明，该创新型水焊机在性能（M = 4.55）、效率（M = 4.55）、安全性（M = 4.56）、耐久性（M = 4.55）和可靠性（M = 4.55）方面均获得很高的功能性评价。此外，该机器在感知有用性（M = 4.56）、感知易用性（M = 4.55）、用户满意度（M = 4.56）以及使用行为意向（M = 4.56）方面均被评为“非常高可接受”。另外，从创业能力角度看，该创新在成本效益、创收潜力、市场性和可持续性方面均被评为“非常高潜力”。ANOVA 结果显示，按画像变量分组的受访者评价之间不存在统计学显著差异（F = 1.273, p = 0.283）。这些发现表明，创新型水焊机具有功能性、可接受性、可持续性和经济可行性，适用于创业、技术转移和社区推广项目。本研究支持创新扩散理论、技术接受模型和人力资本理论，说明了技术采用、技能发展和创业赋权的重要性。此外，该创新有助于可持续生计创造、技术进步，以及高等教育机构开展面向社区需求的研究与推广工作的使命。

infographic.key_insight: 本研究利用海水电解原理开发了一种低成本水基焊机，并发现其具有很高的功能性、可接受性，以及面向农村创业的良好前景。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该工作表明，如何将本地可获得材料和简单电化学原理转化为面向低资源社区的实用制造技术。
method: 采用研究与开发（R&D）方法，研究设计为描述性开发研究。
通过概念化、设计、制造、测试、验证和评估完成机器构建。
使用经验证的问卷评估功能性、基于 TAM 的可接受性以及创业潜力。
infographic.evidence_signal: 来自 138 名受访者的评价显示，在性能、效率、安全性、耐久性、可靠性、有用性、易用性、满意度和使用意向方面均获得很高评分，并使用 ANOVA 进行比较。
infographic.watch_item: 摘要报告了积极评价，但未提供详细的焊接实验性能数据或长期现场耐久性结果，因此实际部署仍需进一步验证。

title: Computational and machine learning modelling approaches for weld quality predictions in friction stir welding of high-density polyethylene
authors: A. Alhourani, I. Barsoum, J. Sheikh-Ahmad, S. Deveci
abstract: Friction stir welding (FSW) has gained recognition as an effective technique for joining thermoplastic materials. This study presents a comprehensive investigation to predict FSW characteristics such as weld temperatures, vertical axial forces, material flow and defect formation in FSW of high-density polyethylene (HDPE) using both computational and machine learning approaches, validated by experimental results. A three-dimensional Coupled Eulerian-Lagrangian (CEL) numerical model is developed to simulate the HDPE welding process under varying process parameters of rotational and welding speeds, and bottom preheating conditions. The CEL numerical model is validated against experimental data, showing markedly good agreement in predicting void formation, thermal and mechanical responses. Results indicate that preheating the bottom surface proved effective in reducing thermal gradients and stabilizing vertical force fluctuations. Quantitatively, bottom-surface preheating at 60 °C reduced peak plunge force from 1600 N close to 1100 N and raised peak temperatures from 70 °C (without preheat) to about 100 °C, hence smoothing through-thickness gradients and stabilizing the axial force distribution. In parallel, two multilayer perceptron artificial neural networks (ANNs) are trained on experimental data to predict temporal temperature and axial force responses with R2 between 0.91 and 0.99, demonstrating high accuracy and strong generalization across the tested FSW parameter space. The computational CEL simulations accurately predicted weld zone morphology, including stir zone, thermo-mechanically affected zone and heat-affected zone, however the combined CEL–ANN framework enables rapid generation of process maps that highlights defective and defect-free welding windows, with optimal conditions obtained at 1500 rpm and 30 mm/min with 60 °C preheating, and poor weldability observed at 1000 rpm without preheating due to wormhole formation. These findings provide process-driven design guidelines for developing robust HDPE joints and demonstrate how integrating computational modeling with machine learning enables efficient optimization, offering valuable insights into the key characteristics of the FSW process in thermoplastics and supporting its broader adoption in industrial applications.

infographic.key_insight: A combined CEL simulation and ANN framework can accurately predict weld temperature, axial force, and defect formation in friction stir welding of HDPE, enabling rapid identification of defect-free process windows.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The study provides practical process maps and design guidance for optimizing thermoplastic FSW by balancing rotation speed, travel speed, and preheating to improve joint quality and force stability.
method: 3D coupled Eulerian-Lagrangian (CEL) model of HDPE FSW
Two multilayer perceptron ANNs trained on experimental temperature and axial-force histories
Parameter sweep over rotational speed, welding speed, and bottom preheating to map defects vs. safe windows
infographic.evidence_signal: The ANN models achieved strong predictive performance with R2 values between 0.91 and 0.99, and the CEL results agreed well with experimental observations of voids, thermal response, and forces.
infographic.watch_item: The trained models and process maps are likely specific to the tested HDPE setup and parameter range, so transfer to other polymers, tool geometries, or thicknesses may require retraining and revalidation.
infographic.paper_title: Computational and machine learning modelling approaches for weld quality predictions in friction stir welding of high-density polyethylene

zh-Hans.title: 用于高密度聚乙烯搅拌摩擦焊焊接质量预测的计算与机器学习建模方法
zh-Hans.abstract: 搅拌摩擦焊（FSW）作为一种用于连接热塑性材料的有效技术，已获得广泛认可。本研究采用计算方法与机器学习方法，结合实验结果验证，对高密度聚乙烯（HDPE）搅拌摩擦焊中的焊接温度、竖直轴向力、材料流动及缺陷形成等FSW特征进行预测，开展了全面研究。建立了三维耦合欧拉-拉格朗日（CEL）数值模型，用于模拟在不同工艺参数——转速、焊接速度以及底部预热条件——下的HDPE焊接过程。CEL数值模型通过实验数据验证，在预测孔洞形成、热响应和力学响应方面表现出显著良好的一致性。结果表明，对底表面进行预热可有效降低热梯度并稳定竖直力波动。定量而言，底表面在60 °C预热时，峰值压入力由接近1600 N降至约1100 N，同时峰值温度由70 °C（无预热）升至约100 °C，从而平滑厚度方向的梯度并稳定轴向力分布。与此同时，基于实验数据训练了两个多层感知机人工神经网络（ANN），用于预测时间温度和轴向力响应，R2介于0.91和0.99之间，表明其具有较高精度和较强的泛化能力，适用于所测试的FSW参数空间。计算CEL仿真能够准确预测焊缝区形貌，包括搅拌区、热-机影响区和热影响区；然而，CEL–ANN联合框架可快速生成工艺图，突出显示有缺陷与无缺陷的焊接窗口。最佳条件为1500 rpm和30 mm/min，并配合60 °C预热；而在1000 rpm且无预热条件下，由于形成虫孔而观察到较差的可焊性。这些发现为开发稳健的HDPE接头提供了基于工艺的设计指南，并表明将计算建模与机器学习相结合能够实现高效优化，为理解热塑性材料FSW过程的关键特征提供有价值的见解，并支持其在工业应用中的更广泛采用。

infographic.key_insight: 将CEL仿真与ANN框架结合，可准确预测HDPE搅拌摩擦焊中的焊接温度、轴向力和缺陷形成，从而快速识别无缺陷的工艺窗口。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 本研究提供了实用的工艺图和设计指导，通过平衡转速、行进速度和预热来优化热塑性材料FSW，以提高接头质量和力稳定性。
method: HDPE FSW的三维耦合欧拉-拉格朗日（CEL）模型
基于实验温度和轴向力历程训练的两个多层感知机ANN
围绕转速、焊接速度和底部预热的参数扫描，以绘制缺陷与安全窗口的对应关系
infographic.evidence_signal: ANN模型取得了较强的预测性能，R2值介于0.91和0.99之间，且CEL结果与孔洞、热响应和力的实验观测高度一致。
infographic.watch_item: 训练得到的模型和工艺图可能仅适用于所测试的HDPE装置和参数范围，因此推广到其他聚合物、工具几何形状或厚度时，可能需要重新训练和再验证。

title: "Anomalous Solid Solution" in Ultra-High Melting Point Oxides: A New Strategy for Developing Ultra-High Temperature Thermal Protection Coatings
authors: Yubo Wang, Hong Meng, Pengfei He, Shujun Hu, Chuan Sun, Ximing Duan
abstract: The high-temperature performance of ultra-high temperature ceramics (UHTCs) in atmospheric environment is fundamentally governed by their melting points of oxidation products. Typical high-melting-point oxides, such as ZrO2, undergo phase transformations at elevated temperatures, leading to structural instability. Although doping with rare-earth or transition-metal cations can suppress these transformations, it often results in a reduction in melting point, thereby limiting practical service temperature. Here, ytterbia-stabilized zirconia (YbSZ) coatings are prepared via atmospheric plasma spraying, achieving a remarkable increase in the melting point of ZrO2 to approximately 2850 $^\circ\mathrm{C}$ and raising the ultimate plasma and oxyacetylene ablation temperature up to nearly 2780 $^\circ\mathrm{C}$ and 3200 $^\circ\mathrm{C}$, which is the highest temperature resistance property as reported. Notably, this performance enhancement originates from a synergistic mechanism of strengthened ionic-covalent mixed bonding and improved oxygen vacancy stability. Based on these findings, the concept of "anomalous solid solution" is firstly proposed to be used in the area of ultra-high temperature protection, which provides new insights into the compositional design of UHTC systems.

infographic.key_insight: YbSZ coatings create an “anomalous solid solution” that boosts zirconia’s melting point and high-temperature stability through stronger mixed bonding and more stable oxygen vacancies.
infographic.engineering_relevance: This offers a new design route for ultra-high-temperature thermal protection coatings that can survive extreme oxidation and ablation conditions beyond conventional doped oxides.
method: Atmospheric plasma-sprayed ytterbia-stabilized zirconia (YbSZ) coatings
Compositional stabilization of ZrO2 to suppress phase instability
Mechanism linked to ionic-covalent mixed bonding and oxygen-vacancy stabilization
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports a ZrO2 melting point near 2850 °C and ultimate plasma/oxyacetylene ablation resistance up to about 2780 °C and 3200 °C, respectively.
infographic.watch_item: The anomalous solid-solution strategy may be composition- and process-sensitive, so reproducibility and long-term thermal cycling stability will need validation in real service environments.
infographic.paper_title: "Anomalous Solid Solution" in Ultra-High Melting Point Oxides: A New Strategy for Developing Ultra-High Temperature Thermal Protection Coatings

zh-Hans.title: 《超高熔点氧化物中的“异常固溶体”：开发超高温热防护涂层的新策略》
zh-Hans.abstract: 超高温陶瓷（UHTCs）在大气环境中的高温性能，从根本上受其氧化产物熔点的制约。典型的高熔点氧化物，如 ZrO2，在高温下会发生相变，导致结构不稳定。尽管通过掺杂稀土或过渡金属阳离子可以抑制这些相变，但这往往会降低熔点，从而限制实际服役温度。本文采用大气等离子喷涂制备了氧化镱稳定氧化锆（YbSZ）涂层，将 ZrO2 的熔点显著提高至约 2850 °C，并将最终的等离子和氧乙炔烧蚀温度分别提升至接近 2780 °C 和 3200 °C，这一耐温性能为目前报道中的最高水平。值得注意的是，这种性能提升源于增强的离子-共价混合键合与提高的氧空位稳定性所共同作用的协同机制。基于这些发现，首次提出“异常固溶体”概念用于超高温防护领域，为 UHTC 体系的成分设计提供了新的认识。

infographic.key_insight: YbSZ 涂层形成一种“异常固溶体”，通过更强的混合键合和更稳定的氧空位提升了氧化锆的熔点及高温稳定性。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这为超高温热防护涂层提供了一条新的设计路线，使其能够在远超传统掺杂氧化物的极端氧化和烧蚀条件下服役。
method: 大气等离子喷涂制备氧化镱稳定氧化锆（YbSZ）涂层
通过成分稳定化 ZrO2 以抑制相不稳定性
将机理归因于离子-共价混合键合与氧空位稳定化
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告 ZrO2 的熔点接近 2850 °C，且最终的等离子/氧乙炔烧蚀耐受温度分别约为 2780 °C 和 3200 °C。
infographic.watch_item: 异常固溶体策略可能对成分和工艺较为敏感，因此其可重复性以及长期热循环稳定性仍需在真实服役环境中验证。

title: Robust Monitoring of Arc Welding Processes: A Generalizable Framework with DVAE and Particle Filter
authors: Yue Cao, Hai Lin, YuMing Zhang
abstract: Arc welding processes are essential for continuous fabrication but prone to disturbances that impair weld quality, making real-time monitoring critical yet difficult due to complex visual patterns and nonlinear, time-varying dynamics. Deep learning shows promise but faces scalability limits because of its dependence on large labeled datasets and application-specific tuning. We explore whether a unified approach can characterize major arc welding processes across applications and improve scalability through consistent state monitoring. This paper introduces a robust and generalizable monitoring framework for arc welding. It combines unsupervised deep latent representation learning, which extracts compact features from weld pool images, with Bayesian filtering to handle persistent and fluctuating disturbances such as arc radiation and specular reflections. Specifically, a Dynamic Variational Autoencoder (DVAE), consisting of a CNN-based encoder-decoder and an LSTM-based transition model, jointly learns latent representations and their evolution under control inputs. For robust real-time inference, a specialized Particle Filter (PF) propagates the latent and LSTM hidden states, preserving process history while suppressing sensor noise. This design is well suited to welding's slow and inertial dynamics. Validation on GTAW and GMAW without process-specific tuning demonstrates the framework's generalizability and robustness.

infographic.key_insight: A DVAE plus particle filter can robustly monitor arc welding by learning compact weld-pool states and tracking their evolution despite noise and disturbances.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The framework aims to provide real-time, generalizable quality monitoring across different welding processes without process-specific tuning.
method: Unsupervised CNN-based DVAE learns latent weld-pool representations from images.
LSTM transition model captures time evolution under control inputs.
Particle filter tracks latent and hidden states to suppress arc radiation and reflection noise.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports validation on both GTAW and GMAW, showing generalizability and robustness without process-specific tuning.
infographic.watch_item: Performance may depend on reliable image acquisition and careful particle-filter state design in strongly disturbed shop-floor conditions.
infographic.paper_title: Robust Monitoring of Arc Welding Processes: A Generalizable Framework with DVAE and Particle Filter

zh-Hans.title: 基于DVAE和粒子滤波器的弧焊过程鲁棒监测：一个可泛化框架
zh-Hans.abstract: 弧焊过程对于连续制造至关重要，但易受扰动影响而降低焊缝质量，因此实时监测十分关键；然而，由于复杂的视觉模式和非线性、时变动力学，这一任务也很困难。深度学习显示出潜力，但由于依赖大量标注数据且需要针对特定应用进行调参，其可扩展性受到限制。我们探讨一种统一方法能否跨应用表征主要弧焊过程，并通过一致的状态监测提高可扩展性。本文提出一种用于弧焊的鲁棒且可泛化的监测框架。该框架将无监督深度潜在表征学习与贝叶斯滤波相结合：前者从熔池图像中提取紧凑特征，后者处理如电弧辐射和镜面反射等持续性与波动性扰动。具体而言，动态变分自编码器（DVAE）由基于CNN的编码器-解码器和基于LSTM的转移模型组成，可联合学习潜在表征及其在控制输入下的演化。为实现鲁棒的实时推断，设计了一种专门的粒子滤波器（PF）来传播潜在状态和LSTM隐藏状态，在抑制传感器噪声的同时保留过程历史。该设计非常适合焊接缓慢且具有惯性的动力学特性。对GTAW和GMAW的验证在无需针对特定过程调参的情况下表明，该框架具有良好的可泛化性和鲁棒性。

infographic.key_insight: DVAE结合粒子滤波器可通过学习紧凑的熔池状态并在噪声和扰动下跟踪其演化，实现对弧焊的鲁棒监测。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该框架旨在为不同焊接过程提供实时、可泛化的质量监测，而无需针对特定过程进行调参。
method: 无监督的基于CNN的DVAE从图像中学习熔池潜在表征。
LSTM转移模型捕捉控制输入下的时间演化。
粒子滤波器跟踪潜在状态和隐藏状态，以抑制电弧辐射和反射噪声。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告了对GTAW和GMAW两种工艺的验证，表明该方法在无需针对特定过程调参的情况下具有可泛化性和鲁棒性。
infographic.watch_item: 在强干扰的车间环境中，其性能可能取决于可靠的图像采集以及粒子滤波状态设计是否得当。

title: Enhanced Seam Segmentation for Automated Welding Robot in Construction Through Transfer Learning: Addressing Limitations of Bilateral Segmentation Network
authors: Keonvin Park, Yong Ann Voeurn, Hyeokjun Kweon, Doyun Lee
abstract: Reliable seam segmentation is essential for autonomous robotic welding in construction, where harsh illumination, specular reflections, and thin weld geometries often degrade segmentation performance. This study proposes a reflection-robust seam segmentation framework that enhances a BiSeNetV2 backbone through transfer learning and a hybrid Cross-Entropy--Lovász loss. Rather than increasing architectural complexity, the proposed framework improves reflection robustness through learning-stability-oriented optimization. Experimental results show that the proposed method achieves 81.76\% Joint IoU and 90.73\% mIoU, improving Joint IoU by +22.36 percentage points over the OHEM-based baseline while maintaining identical FLOPs, parameter count, and inference speed. The proposed approach also recovers 96.33\% of severe zero-IoU failure cases under reflective conditions. Comparative experiments across BiSeNetV2, DeepLabV3+, UNet, and SegFormer further demonstrate that the proposed optimization strategy is particularly effective for lightweight real-time segmentation architectures. Qualitative analyses additionally show improved seam continuity and reflection robustness in challenging welding environments. These findings suggest that the proposed framework provides a practical and lightweight perception solution for robotic welding applications involving reflective metallic surfaces.

infographic.key_insight: A transfer-learning plus hybrid Cross-Entropy–Lovász loss upgrade to BiSeNetV2 substantially improves reflective seam segmentation without adding model complexity.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The method offers a lightweight, real-time perception boost for autonomous welding robots operating on shiny, hard-to-segment construction surfaces.
method: Start from BiSeNetV2 and apply transfer learning for seam segmentation.
Use a hybrid Cross-Entropy–Lovász optimization to improve boundary and overlap quality.
Target reflection-robust learning rather than increasing network size or runtime cost.
infographic.evidence_signal: The proposed method reached 81.76% Joint IoU and 90.73% mIoU, improving Joint IoU by 22.36 points over the OHEM baseline while keeping FLOPs, parameters, and inference speed unchanged.
infographic.watch_item: Performance gains are shown in a specific welding dataset and may require careful validation when deployed on new geometries, lighting setups, or camera conditions.
infographic.paper_title: Enhanced Seam Segmentation for Automated Welding Robot in Construction Through Transfer Learning: Addressing Limitations of Bilateral Segmentation Network

zh-Hans.title: 通过迁移学习增强用于建筑自动焊接机器人的焊缝分割：解决双边分割网络的局限性
zh-Hans.abstract: 可靠的焊缝分割对于建筑场景中的自主机器人焊接至关重要，因为恶劣照明、镜面反射以及细窄焊缝几何形状常常会降低分割性能。本研究提出了一种抗反射焊缝分割框架，通过迁移学习和混合 Cross-Entropy--Lovász 损失来增强 BiSeNetV2 主干网络。与增加架构复杂度不同，所提出的框架通过面向学习稳定性的优化来提升抗反射能力。实验结果表明，所提出的方法达到 81.76% 的 Joint IoU 和 90.73% 的 mIoU，在保持 FLOPs、参数量和推理速度完全相同的情况下，相较于基于 OHEM 的基线将 Joint IoU 提高了 22.36 个百分点。所提出的方法还恢复了 96.33% 的严重零 IoU 失效案例在反射条件下的性能。针对 BiSeNetV2、DeepLabV3+、UNet 和 SegFormer 的比较实验进一步表明，所提出的优化策略对轻量级实时分割架构尤其有效。定性分析还显示，在具有挑战性的焊接环境中，焊缝连续性和抗反射能力均有所提升。这些结果表明，所提出的框架为涉及反射性金属表面的机器人焊接应用提供了一种实用且轻量化的感知解决方案。

infographic.key_insight: 通过迁移学习加上混合 Cross-Entropy–Lovász 损失对 BiSeNetV2 进行升级，可在不增加模型复杂度的情况下显著提升反射条件下的焊缝分割性能。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该方法为在光亮、难以分割的建筑表面上运行的自主焊接机器人提供了轻量级、实时的感知性能提升。
method: 以 BiSeNetV2 为起点，并应用迁移学习进行焊缝分割。
采用混合 Cross-Entropy–Lovász 优化，以提升边界质量和重叠质量。
优先面向抗反射学习，而不是增加网络规模或运行时成本。
infographic.evidence_signal: 所提出的方法达到 81.76% 的 Joint IoU 和 90.73% 的 mIoU，在保持 FLOPs、参数量和推理速度不变的情况下，相较于 OHEM 基线将 Joint IoU 提高了 22.36 个百分点。
infographic.watch_item: 性能提升是在特定焊接数据集上展示的，部署到新的几何形状、照明设置或相机条件时，可能需要谨慎验证。

title: Influence of Oxygen Content upon Molten Pool Dynamics in Submerged Arc Welding
authors: American Welding Society, Hangyu Bai, Yanyun Zhang, Guanyi Wang, CONG WANG, ZUSHU LI
abstract: In submerged arc welding, complex oxygen transport from the flux critically governs molten-pool dynamics by altering surface tension, yet the underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood. This study addresses this critical gap by developing a comprehensive numerical framework that, for the first time, couples a multi-pathway oxygen transport model with dynamic, region-specific surface tension calculations. Analysis of simulation results across varying oxygen levels reveals that the specific oxygen level dictates the competition between centrifugal spreading and centripetal return flows. Under low oxygen conditions, spreading flow dominates, resulting in a wider molten pool. Conversely, as oxygen content increases, Marangoni convection reverses: outward spreading flow diminishes while centripetal flow intensifies, leading to a significant contraction in the molten pool width. Furthermore, higher oxygen content induces an internal vortex that drives deeper penetration and delays solidification at the rear. This work elucidates the mechanism governing the transition in flow patterns driven by oxygen content and provides a physical basis for controlling weld formation by regulating the flux oxygen supply.

infographic.key_insight: Oxygen content in submerged arc welding controls surface-tension-driven flow reversal in the molten pool, shifting the balance from wide outward spreading to narrower inward-return circulation and deeper penetration.
infographic.engineering_relevance: By regulating flux oxygen supply, welders can tune bead width, penetration depth, and rear solidification behavior to improve weld formation control.
method: Developed a numerical framework coupling multi-pathway oxygen transport with dynamic, region-specific surface tension.
Simulated molten-pool flow across varying oxygen levels to track Marangoni convection and vortex formation.
Compared spreading vs. centripetal flow dominance to explain changes in pool shape and solidification behavior.
infographic.evidence_signal: Simulation results across oxygen levels showed flow-pattern transitions, pool-width contraction at higher oxygen, and deeper penetration with delayed rear solidification.
infographic.watch_item: The framework is simulation-based, so practical transferability depends on how well flux oxygen transport and surface-tension parameters match real welding conditions.
infographic.paper_title: Influence of Oxygen Content upon Molten Pool Dynamics in Submerged Arc Welding

zh-Hans.title: 氧含量对埋弧焊熔池动力学的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 在埋弧焊中，来自焊剂的复杂氧传输通过改变表面张力而关键性地支配熔池动力学，但其内在机理仍未得到充分理解。本研究通过构建一个综合数值框架来解决这一关键空白，该框架首次将多路径氧传输模型与动态的、分区域表面张力计算相耦合。对不同氧含量条件下的模拟结果分析表明，特定氧水平决定了离心扩展流与向心回流之间的竞争关系。在低氧条件下，扩展流占主导，导致熔池更宽。相反，随着氧含量增加，马兰戈尼对流发生反转：外向扩展流减弱，而向心流增强，从而使熔池宽度显著收缩。此外，更高的氧含量会诱发内部涡旋，促进更深的熔深并延迟后部凝固。本研究阐明了由氧含量驱动的流动模式转变机制，并通过调控焊剂供氧为焊缝成形控制提供了物理基础。

infographic.key_insight: 埋弧焊中的氧含量通过控制熔池内由表面张力驱动的流动反转，使流动平衡从宽阔的外向扩展转向更窄的内向回流循环，并带来更深的熔深。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 通过调节焊剂供氧，焊工可以调整焊缝宽度、熔深和后部凝固行为，以提升焊缝成形控制效果。
method: 建立了一个将多路径氧传输与动态分区域表面张力相耦合的数值框架。
在不同氧水平下模拟熔池流动，以跟踪马兰戈尼对流和涡旋形成。
比较扩展流与向心流的主导性，以解释熔池形状和凝固行为的变化。
infographic.evidence_signal: 不同氧水平下的模拟结果显示了流动模式转变、更高氧含量下的熔池宽度收缩，以及更深的熔深和后部凝固延迟。
infographic.watch_item: 该框架基于模拟，因此其实际可迁移性取决于焊剂氧传输和表面张力参数与真实焊接条件的匹配程度。

title: Hybrid Graphene Nanoplatelet/C60 Nanocomposite Modification of HVOF-Metallized Carbon Fiber-Reinforced Polymer Coatings to Improve Adhesion, Barrier Performance, and Surface Functionality
authors: Iram Riaz, Xingyu Wang, Hong Pan, Zhibin Lin
abstract: Thermally sprayed metallic coatings on carbon fiber-reinforced polymer (CFRP) substrates often contain pores and microstructural defects that can reduce adhesion, durability, and protective performance. In this study, a hybrid graphene nanoplatelet (GNP)-fullerene C60 reinforced epoxy coating was applied to HVOF-metallized CFRP, while a carbon nanotube (CNT)-based surface treatment was used to modify surface wettability. Micro-CT and SEM analyses indicated morphological changes consistent with partial coverage of accessible surface-connected defects and modification of the metallized layer surface. Pull-off adhesion strength increased from 320 psi to 650 psi, accompanied by a shift from adhesive to cohesive failure. The optimal nanofiller formulation improved tensile strength from approximately 25 MPa to 56 MPa (124%) and Young’s modulus by approximately 47% compared with neat epoxy. Abrasion testing showed more than 50% reduction in mass loss, and electrochemical impedance spectroscopy indicated improved barrier performance after 200 h of salt spray exposure. CNT surface modification transformed the coating from hydrophilic to superhydrophobic behavior, achieving water contact angles above 155°, delaying ice formation, and reducing ice accumulation. These results indicate that combining hybrid nanocomposite coatings with CNT functionalization can improve mechanical, protective, and surface-functional performance of HVOF-metallized CFRP systems under the laboratory conditions investigated.

infographic.key_insight: A hybrid GNP/C60 epoxy topcoat plus CNT surface treatment substantially improved adhesion, barrier protection, wear resistance, and superhydrophobicity on HVOF-metallized CFRP.
infographic.engineering_relevance: This approach offers a practical path to make sprayed metallized CFRP coatings more durable and multifunctional for harsh-service aerospace and structural applications.

Evaluated morphology, adhesion, tensile properties, abrasion, impedance, and ice-response performance.

zh-Hans.title: HVOF-金属化碳纤维增强聚合物涂层的石墨烯纳米片/C60富勒烯杂化纳米复合改性以提高附着力、阻隔性能和表面功能性
zh-Hans.abstract: 热喷涂金属涂层在碳纤维增强聚合物（CFRP）基体上通常含有孔隙和微观结构缺陷，这些缺陷会降低附着力、耐久性和防护性能。本研究中，将石墨烯纳米片（GNP）-富勒烯C60增强环氧涂层施加于HVOF金属化CFRP，同时采用基于碳纳米管（CNT）的表面处理来调控表面润湿性。Micro-CT和SEM分析表明，其形貌变化与可接触表面连通缺陷的部分覆盖以及金属化层表面改性一致。拉脱附着强度由320 psi提高至650 psi，并伴随失效模式由黏附破坏转变为内聚破坏。最优纳米填料配方使拉伸强度较纯环氧从约25 MPa提高到56 MPa（124%），杨氏模量提高约47%。耐磨试验显示质量损失降低超过50%，电化学阻抗谱表明在200 h盐雾暴露后阻隔性能得到改善。CNT表面改性使涂层由亲水行为转变为超疏水行为，水接触角超过155°，延缓了结冰并减少了冰积累。结果表明，在所研究的实验室条件下，将杂化纳米复合涂层与CNT功能化相结合，可提升HVOF金属化CFRP体系的力学、防护和表面功能性能。

infographic.engineering_relevance: 该方法为使喷涂金属化CFRP涂层在严苛服役的航空航天和结构应用中更耐久、更多功能，提供了一条实用路径。

title: Multilayer Gradient Design for Stress Mitigation and Durability Enhancement in Plasma-Sprayed La₂Zr₂O₇/NiCoCrAlY Coatings
authors: Tian Liu, Qian Wang, Heng Nan Ding, Rui Luo
abstract: This study systematically investigates the microstructure and high-temperature performance of plasma-sprayed La₂Zr₂O₇/NiCoCrAlY (LZO/NAY) thermal barrier coatings (TBCs) with double-layer, three-layer, and five-layer gradient architectures. To address interfacial stress accumulation caused by mismatches in thermal expansion coefficients between ceramic and metallic layers, multilayer compositional gradients were introduced. Microstructural characterization was performed using SEM, EBSD, and TEM, while finite element modeling was used to evaluate thermal insulation and stress distribution. The five-layer gradient coatings exhibited the smoothest compositional transition and most uniform stress distribution, significantly reducing interfacial stress concentration and residual stresses. Thermal shock resistance tests at 1200 °C demonstrated that the five-layer coatings withstood 24 cycles, a marked improvement compared to 18 and 3 cycles for three-layer and double-layer systems, respectively. Isothermal oxidation tests at 1000 °C further showed that gradient coatings maintained superior structural integrity, with thinner thermally grown oxide layers than the conventional system. The findings provide both theoretical and experimental evidence that compositional gradient design markedly enhances the durability and thermal stability of TBCs, offering practical strategies for advanced thermal protection in high-temperature applications.

infographic.engineering_relevance: The design offers a practical route to extend thermal barrier coating life in gas turbines and other extreme-temperature systems by mitigating thermal mismatch damage.
method: Built double-layer, three-layer, and five-layer LZO/NAY gradient thermal barrier coatings by plasma spraying.
Characterized microstructure and interfaces using SEM, EBSD, and TEM.

zh-Hans.title: 用于缓解应力和提升耐久性的等离子喷涂 La₂Zr₂O₇/NiCoCrAlY 涂层多层梯度设计
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究系统考察了等离子喷涂 La₂Zr₂O₇/NiCoCrAlY（LZO/NAY）热障涂层（TBCs）的微观组织及高温性能，涵盖双层、三层和五层梯度结构。为应对陶瓷层与金属层热膨胀系数不匹配所引起的界面应力累积，引入了多层成分梯度。采用 SEM、EBSD 和 TEM 进行微观组织表征，并通过有限元建模评估隔热性能和应力分布。五层梯度涂层表现出最平缓的成分过渡和最均匀的应力分布，显著降低了界面应力集中和残余应力。1200 °C 下的热震试验表明，五层涂层可承受 24 个循环，相比之下，三层和双层体系分别仅为 18 个和 3 个循环，提升显著。1000 °C 下的恒温氧化试验进一步表明，梯度涂层保持了更优的结构完整性，其热生长氧化层比传统体系更薄。研究结果为成分梯度设计可显著增强 TBCs 的耐久性和热稳定性提供了理论与实验依据，并为高温应用中的先进热防护提供了实用策略。

title: Tribological enhancement of Al 2 O 3 -TiO 2 D-gun coated Ti-6Al-4V alloy: A machine learning approach
authors: Selwyn Jebadurai Devaraj, A. Arul Jeya Kumar, A Queen Alice, V Manoj Kumar, S Arokya Agustin, A Sarath Chandra
abstract: Ti-6Al-4V alloy is used a lot in aerospace, biomedical and marine applications. This study investigates the tribological behaviour of Al 2 O 3 -TiO 2 coated and uncoated Ti-6Al-4V alloy by experimental and machine learning approaches. An Al 2 O 3 -TiO 2 ceramic coating, approximately 200 µm thick, was applied to Ti-6Al-4V alloy via the detonation gun (D-gun) process under regulated conditions (oxygen flow: 4800 SLPH, acetylene: 2150 SLPH, stand-off distance: 180 mm, particle velocity ∼1200 m/s). The wear behaviour of samples was tested using a pin-on-disc apparatus in accordance with ASTM G99 standards. Tests were conducted under normal loads of 40–100 N, sliding speeds of 100–200 rpm and durations of 20–40 min against an EN31 steel counter face. Scanning electron microscopy demonstrated that coated surfaces exhibited reduced wear and formed a protective tribo-layer. Machine learning models such as artificial neural networks, K-nearest neighbours and random forest were developed to predict wear based on sliding parameters. Random forest proved to be the best choice with less mean percentage error and mean squared error. The results showed that D-gun deposited Al 2 O 3 -TiO 2 coatings improved the wear performance of Ti-6Al-4V.
venue: Proceedings of the Institution of Mechanical Engineers Part E Journal of Process Mechanical Engineering

infographic.engineering_relevance: This suggests detonation-sprayed ceramic coatings can extend titanium alloy life in aerospace, biomedical, and marine tribological components.

zh-Hans.abstract: Ti-6Al-4V 合金广泛用于航空航天、生物医学和海洋应用。本研究采用实验与机器学习方法，研究了 Al 2 O 3 -TiO 2 涂层与未涂层 Ti-6Al-4V 合金的摩擦学行为。在受控条件下（氧气流量：4800 SLPH、乙炔：2150 SLPH、喷距：180 mm、颗粒速度约 1200 m/s），通过爆炸喷枪（D-gun）工艺在 Ti-6Al-4V 合金表面制备了约 200 µm 厚的 Al 2 O 3 -TiO 2 陶瓷涂层。按照 ASTM G99 标准，使用销盘式试验装置测试了样品的磨损行为。试验在 40–100 N 的法向载荷、100–200 rpm 的滑动速度以及 20–40 min 的持续时间下，针对 EN31 钢对偶面进行。扫描电子显微镜结果表明，涂层表面磨损减小，并形成了保护性摩擦层。基于人工神经网络、K 近邻和随机森林等机器学习模型，依据滑动参数对磨损进行预测。随机森林表现最佳，具有更低的平均百分误差和均方误差。结果表明，D-gun 沉积的 Al 2 O 3 -TiO 2 涂层提高了 Ti-6Al-4V 的耐磨性能。

title: Hot corrosion behavior of thermal sprayed using HVAF and DS techniques with Tribaloy-400 coatings for solar energy storage container
authors: P. Sakthivel, G. Sivakumar, M. Manikandan
abstract: The present study investigates the high-temperature corrosion behaviour of Tribaloy-400 (T-400) coatings deposited on ASTM A516 steel using two thermal spray techniques: (i) High Velocity Air Fuel (HVAF) spraying and (ii) Detonation Spraying (DS). The coated specimens were exposed to a molten solar salt environment consisting of 60% NaNO 3 –40% KNO 3 at 500 °C for exposure durations up to 1000 hours to evaluate their oxidation and corrosion resistance. Phase analysis indicated the formation of stable protective oxide phases, including Cr 2 O 3 , Co 3 O 4 , and CoMoO 4 , in both coating systems. Elemental mapping revealed that the HVAF coating retained a uniform Cr–Mo–Si–O enriched surface with minimal molten salt penetration even after prolonged exposure of 1000 hours. In contrast, the DS coating exhibited comparatively deeper salt ingress into the coating microstructure, which contributed to increased degradation and spallation. SEM observations showed that the HVAF coatings possessed a dense and well-bonded microstructure, along with the formation of thermodynamically stable oxides such as Cr 2 O 3 , CoCr 2 O 4 , and CoMoO 4 , resulting in superior resistance to molten salt-induced corrosion. However, the relatively porous nature of the DS coating promoted salt-assisted oxide dissolution, leading to higher mass gain, increased spallation, and accelerated degradation during extended exposure. Comparative evaluation of both coating techniques was carried out to identify a suitable coating process and feedstock combination for high-temperature CSP applications.
venue: Journal of Materials Research and Technology

zh-Hans.title: 用于太阳能储能容器的HVAF和DS技术热喷涂Tribaloy-400涂层热腐蚀行为
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究考察了采用两种热喷涂技术沉积在ASTM A516钢上的Tribaloy-400（T-400）涂层的高温腐蚀行为：(i) 高速空气燃料（HVAF）喷涂和(ii) 爆炸喷涂（DS）。将涂覆试样置于由60% NaNO3–40% KNO3组成的熔融太阳盐环境中，在500 °C下暴露最长达1000小时，以评估其抗氧化和耐腐蚀性能。相分析表明，两种涂层体系中均形成了稳定的保护性氧化物相，包括Cr2O3、Co3O4和CoMoO4。元素映射显示，即使在1000小时长时间暴露后，HVAF涂层仍保持均匀的Cr–Mo–Si–O富集表面，且熔盐渗透极少。相比之下，DS涂层表现出相对更深的盐进入涂层微观结构，这促成了更严重的劣化和剥落。SEM观察表明，HVAF涂层具有致密且结合良好的微观结构，并伴随形成Cr2O3、CoCr2O4和CoMoO4等热力学稳定氧化物，从而表现出更优异的抗熔盐腐蚀性能。然而，DS涂层相对多孔的特性促进了盐辅助氧化物溶解，导致更高的增重、更严重的剥落以及在长时间暴露过程中的更快劣化。对两种涂层技术进行了比较评估，以确定适用于高温CSP应用的合适涂层工艺与原料组合。

试样在500 °C下暴露于60% NaNO3–40% KNO3熔融太阳盐中，最长达1000 h。
通过相分析、SEM、元素映射以及增重/剥落观察评估腐蚀/氧化行为。

title: Effect of Barrel Filling Ratio on the Microstructure, Phase Composition and Tribological Performance of Detonation-Sprayed Cr3C2–NiCr Coatings
authors: Zhuldyz Sagdoldina, Aiym Nabioldina, Daryn Baizhan, Nurbol Berdimuratov, Gulsym Bektasova
abstract: This study investigates the influence of barrel filling ratio on the microstructure, phase composition, and tribological performance of detonation-sprayed Cr3C2–NiCr coatings. Coatings were deposited at barrel filling ratios of 43% and 53% under identical spraying conditions. Microstructural characterization revealed the formation of dense lamellar coatings with low porosity and uniform distribution of Cr3C2 carbide particles within the NiCr metallic matrix. Compared with the coating deposited at a barrel filling ratio of 43%, the coating deposited at 53% exhibited a denser microstructure. X-ray diffraction analysis confirmed that Cr3C2 and NiCr remained the dominant phases after spraying, while a minor amount of Cr7C3 formed due to partial decarburization of chromium carbide during thermal exposure. Tribological performance was evaluated under dry sliding conditions using a ball-on-disc configuration at normal loads of 10 and 15 N and sliding speeds of 5 and 10 cm/s. Wear volume was determined from the geometry of the wear track after testing, and wear rate was calculated accordingly. The coating produced at a barrel filling ratio of 53% demonstrated improved wear resistance under elevated loads despite exhibiting a higher coefficient of friction. The minimum wear rate reached 1.23 × 10−4 mm3/(m·N), which was associated with reduced porosity and enhanced structural integrity of the coating. The obtained results demonstrate that optimization of detonation spraying parameters significantly affects coating structure and tribological behavior. The developed Cr3C2–NiCr coatings are promising protective materials for components operating under severe friction and wear conditions, including industrial and high-temperature engineering applications.

infographic.key_insight: Increasing the detonation-spray barrel filling ratio from 43% to 53% produced denser Cr3C2–NiCr coatings with better wear resistance, even though friction increased.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Optimizing spray barrel filling ratio is a practical way to improve carbide coating integrity and durability for high-wear industrial components.

zh-Hans.title: 炮筒填充比对爆炸喷涂Cr3C2–NiCr涂层微观结构、相组成及摩擦学性能的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究考察了炮筒填充比对爆炸喷涂Cr3C2–NiCr涂层微观结构、相组成及摩擦学性能的影响。在相同喷涂条件下，分别在43%和53%的炮筒填充比下制备涂层。微观结构表征显示，涂层形成了致密的层状结构，孔隙率低，Cr3C2碳化物颗粒在NiCr金属基体中分布均匀。与43%炮筒填充比下制备的涂层相比，53%条件下制备的涂层表现出更致密的微观结构。X射线衍射分析证实，喷涂后Cr3C2和NiCr仍为主要相，而由于热暴露过程中铬碳化物发生部分脱碳，形成了少量Cr7C3。采用球-盘形式在干摩擦条件下对摩擦学性能进行评估，法向载荷为10和15 N，滑动速度为5和10 cm/s。磨损体积通过测试后磨痕几何形貌确定，并据此计算磨损率。53%炮筒填充比制备的涂层在较高载荷下表现出更好的耐磨性能，尽管其摩擦系数更高。最低磨损率达到1.23 × 10−4 mm3/(m·N)，这与涂层孔隙率降低和结构完整性增强有关。结果表明，爆炸喷涂参数的优化会显著影响涂层结构和摩擦学行为。所制备的Cr3C2–NiCr涂层有望作为在严重摩擦和磨损条件下运行部件的防护材料，包括工业和高温工程应用。

infographic.key_insight: 将爆炸喷涂炮筒填充比从43%提高到53%可制备出更致密的Cr3C2–NiCr涂层，并显著提高耐磨性，尽管摩擦有所增加。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 优化喷涂炮筒填充比是提升碳化物涂层致密性和耐久性的实用途径，适用于高磨损工业部件。
method: 在43%和53%炮筒填充比下制备爆炸喷涂Cr3C2–NiCr涂层
使用显微技术和X射线衍射比较微观结构与相组成
采用球-盘试验在10和15 N以及5和10 cm/s条件下评估干滑动磨损
infographic.evidence_signal: 53%涂层孔隙率更低，保持Cr3C2/NiCr为主要相并伴随少量Cr7C3生成，且最低磨损率达到1.23 × 10^-4 mm3/(m·N)。
infographic.watch_item: 53%条件下更好的耐磨性伴随着更高的摩擦系数，因此最佳设置可能取决于优先考虑低摩擦还是最长磨损寿命。

title: Optimising Cold Spray Additive Manufacturing: Pressure-driven enhancement of mechanical performance in copper deposits
authors: Steven Camilleri, Thi Thuy Tien Tran, Keita Nomoto, Andrew Duguid, Matthew Harbidge, Riyan Rashid
abstract: Cold spray additive manufacturing (CSAM) is a solid-state process capable of producing dense metallic components without melting, making it highly attractive for copper applications requiring both electrical conductivity and mechanical integrity. In this study, the influence of spray pressure at 30 bar, 40 bar, 50 bar and 60 bar on particle velocity, microstructure, and properties of cold-sprayed copper was systematically investigated using a LightSPEE3D system. The cold spray deposits were characterised by X-ray diffraction (XRD), hardness testing, eddy current conductivity, tensile evaluation, and scanning electron microscopy (SEM). The results reveal that increasing spray pressure enhances particle velocities beyond the critical threshold for copper, leading to improved inter-particle bonding and microstructural refinement consistent with severe plastic deformation and possible continuous dynamic recrystallisation (cDRX)-assisted mechanisms. XRD analysis suggested progressive crystallite refinement and increased dislocation density with pressure, which directly correlated with improved ductility. While hardness decreased due to recovery and recrystallisation, electrical conductivity increased, likely due to improved inter-particle continuity and reduced interfacial discontinuities. Tensile testing showed a clear strength-ductility transition, with deposits at higher pressures exhibiting substantially improved ductility approaching bulk copper behaviour and fully ductile fracture morphologies. Overall, the findings identify an optimum processing window at higher spray pressures, where copper cold spray deposits achieve a balanced combination of conductivity, ductility, and strength. This study highlights the critical role of spray pressure in controlling the interplay between particle velocity, dynamic recrystallisation, and multifunctional performance in CSAM copper components. This study establishes a process-structure-property relationship linking particle velocity, XRD-derived microstructural evolution, conductivity, and tensile behaviour within a LightSPEE3D CSAM system.

infographic.key_insight: Raising cold-spray pressure from 30 to 60 bar increased particle velocity above the critical deposition threshold for copper, producing denser, better-bonded deposits with higher ductility and conductivity.
infographic.engineering_relevance: For copper CSAM, spray pressure is a primary process lever for balancing mechanical integrity and electrical performance without melting the material.
method: Cold-sprayed copper at 30, 40, 50, and 60 bar using a LightSPEE3D system
Characterised deposits by XRD, SEM, hardness, eddy current conductivity, and tensile testing
Compared microstructure, particle bonding, and property trends versus spray pressure

infographic.watch_item: Higher pressure improved performance, but the apparent recovery/recrystallisation that lowers hardness suggests the optimum window must be tuned to the target strength-conductivity tradeoff.
infographic.paper_title: Optimising Cold Spray Additive Manufacturing: Pressure-driven enhancement of mechanical performance in copper deposits

zh-Hans.title: 冷喷涂增材制造优化：压力驱动提升铜沉积层力学性能
zh-Hans.abstract: 冷喷涂增材制造（CSAM）是一种固态工艺，能够在不发生熔化的情况下制备致密金属构件，因此对于同时要求电导率和机械完整性的铜应用具有很强吸引力。本研究系统考察了在30 bar、40 bar、50 bar和60 bar喷涂压力下，采用LightSPEE3D系统制备的冷喷涂铜中粒子速度、显微组织和性能的影响。通过X射线衍射（XRD）、硬度测试、涡流电导率测试、拉伸评估和扫描电子显微镜（SEM）对冷喷涂沉积层进行了表征。结果表明，随着喷涂压力增加，粒子速度超过铜的临界阈值，从而增强了颗粒间结合，并使显微组织细化，这与剧烈塑性变形以及可能由连续动态再结晶（cDRX）辅助的机制相一致。XRD分析表明，随着压力升高，晶粒尺寸逐步细化、位错密度增加，并且这些变化与延展性改善直接相关。虽然由于回复和再结晶作用硬度降低，但电导率提高，这可能归因于颗粒间连续性改善以及界面不连续性减少。拉伸测试显示出明显的强度-延展性转变，高压力下的沉积层表现出显著提升的延展性，接近块体铜行为，并呈现完全延性断裂形貌。总体而言，研究结果确定了较高喷涂压力下的最佳工艺窗口，在该窗口内铜冷喷涂沉积层可实现电导率、延展性和强度的平衡组合。本研究强调了喷涂压力在控制CSAM铜构件中粒子速度、动态再结晶与多功能性能之间相互作用方面的关键作用。本研究建立了LightSPEE3D CSAM系统内的工艺-组织-性能关系，将粒子速度、基于XRD的显微组织演化、电导率和拉伸行为联系起来。

infographic.key_insight: 将冷喷涂压力从30 bar提高到60 bar，使粒子速度超过铜的临界沉积阈值，形成更致密、结合更好的沉积层，并获得更高的延展性和电导率。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 对于铜CSAM，喷涂压力是平衡机械完整性和电性能的主要工艺调控参数，同时无需使材料熔化。
method: 使用LightSPEE3D系统在30、40、50和60 bar下进行铜冷喷涂
通过XRD、SEM、硬度、涡流电导率和拉伸测试对沉积层进行表征
比较不同喷涂压力下的显微组织、颗粒结合和性能变化趋势
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告了随压力变化的XRD细化、电导率提高、硬度降低，以及在较高压力下拉伸行为从强度主导明显转向延性主导并最终呈现完全延性断裂。
infographic.watch_item: 更高压力提升了性能，但会出现降低硬度的回复/再结晶效应，因此必须根据目标强度-电导率权衡来调整最佳工艺窗口。

title: EFFECT OF ARGON FLOW RATE DURING AIR PLASMA SPRAYING ON THE STRUCTURE AND PROPERTIES OF NICRFEBSIC COATINGS
authors: Dastan Buitkenov, Nurkhat Bimakhan, Nurmakhanbet Raisov
abstract: In this work, self-fluxing metal-ceramic coatings based on the NiCrFeBSiC system were obtained by air plasma spraying, and their structural, mechanical, and tribological properties were investigated.. The effect of argon flow rate (1600 and 1800 L/h) during coating formation was consideredIt was found that an increase in argon flow rate leads to an approximately twofold increase in coating thickness and a twofold decrease in porosity. According to the microhardness measurement results, the microhardness was 1015.8 ± 81.5 HV, while the elastic modulus was 203.9 ± 5.4 GPa. Tribological tests were carried out using the ball-on-disk configurationAt an argon flow rate of 1800 L/h, the friction coefficient showed a lower value (≈0.107), indicating improved wear resistance of the coatings. Scratch test results showed a high level of adhesion between the coatings and the substrate. Although the critical load values (Lc) were similar for both regimes, the coatings obtained at 1800 L/h exhibited a more gradual and stable failure behavior.
venue: Journal of Surface Engineering and Coating Technology

infographic.key_insight: Raising argon flow from 1600 to 1800 L/h during air plasma spraying makes NiCrFeBSiC coatings thicker, denser, and more wear resistant.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Optimizing plasma spray gas flow can improve coating quality and adhesion for protective surface engineering applications.

Compared argon flow rates of 1600 vs 1800 L/h during deposition.
Evaluated structure, microhardness, elastic modulus, scratch adhesion, and ball-on-disk tribology.

infographic.watch_item: The study compares only two argon flow settings, so broader process windows and long-term wear behavior still need validation.

zh-Hans.title: 空气等离子喷涂过程中氩气流量对 NiCrFeBSiC 涂层结构和性能的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究采用空气等离子喷涂制备了基于 NiCrFeBSiC 体系的自熔性金属陶瓷涂层，并研究了其结构、力学和摩擦学性能。考察了涂层形成过程中氩气流量（1600 和 1800 L/h）的影响。结果表明，随着氩气流量增加，涂层厚度约增加一倍，而孔隙率降低一半。根据显微硬度测试结果，显微硬度为 1015.8 ± 81.5 HV，弹性模量为 203.9 ± 5.4 GPa。摩擦学测试采用球-盘配置进行。在氩气流量为 1800 L/h 时，摩擦系数较低（≈0.107），表明涂层的耐磨性有所提高。划痕测试结果表明，涂层与基体之间具有较高的结合强度。尽管两种工况下的临界载荷值（Lc）相近，但在 1800 L/h 下制备的涂层表现出更渐进且更稳定的失效行为。

infographic.key_insight: 将空气等离子喷涂过程中的氩气流量从 1600 提高到 1800 L/h，可使 NiCrFeBSiC 涂层更厚、更致密且更耐磨。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 优化等离子喷涂气体流量可提高涂层质量和结合性能，适用于防护表面工程应用。
method: 采用空气等离子喷涂制备自熔性 NiCrFeBSiC 金属陶瓷涂层。
在沉积过程中比较了 1600 与 1800 L/h 的氩气流量。
评估了结构、显微硬度、弹性模量、划痕结合性能以及球-盘摩擦学性能。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告涂层厚度约增加一倍、孔隙率降低一半、显微硬度为 1015.8 ± 81.5 HV、弹性模量为 203.9 ± 5.4 GPa，并且在 1800 L/h 时摩擦系数更低（≈0.107）。
infographic.watch_item: 该研究仅比较了两种氩气流量设定，因此更宽的工艺窗口和长期磨损行为仍需验证。

title: A Comparative Analysis of Multitask Neural Networks and Stacking Ensemble Learning for Predicting UTS, Weld Hardness, and HAZ Hardness in Welding Applications
authors: Sama Mukhtar, Amit Sata, Gaurang Joshi, Durgesh Srivastava
abstract: Accurately predicting welding performance measures like ultimate strength (UTS), weld bead hardness, and HAZ mechanical hardness is crucial for ensuring the structural integrity and performance of welded components. Multitask learning (MTL) refers to a machine learning approach in which one model is designed to handle several interconnected tasks at the same time. Instead of training separate models for each task, MTL shares representations among tasks, allowing them to leverage common patterns while maintaining task-specific distinctions. In this study, we compared two advanced machine learning techniques, namely multitask neural network (MTNN) and stacking ensemble learning, for predicting these parameters based on a shared dataset. A multitask neural network (MTNN) is a specific type of multitask learning (MTL) model that uses a deep neural network architecture to handle multiple related tasks simultaneously. In MTNN, different tasks share some hidden layers while having task-specific output layers. This shared representation allows the model to learn common patterns across tasks while maintaining task-specific outputs. Both methods are evaluated using RMSE and R<sup>2</sup> to determine their predictive accuracy and overall effectiveness. It showed robust prediction strength, as its RMSE outcomes are 0.1288 for UTS, 0.0886 for weld hardness, and 0.1125 for HAZ hardness, whereas R<sup>2</sup> values are 0.6724, 0.9215, and 0.8407, respectively. This underlines that it can generalize well in interrelated tasks. Stacking ensemble learning outperformed MTL in the accuracy of individual tasks: the RMSE for UTS is 0.0263 and R<sup>2</sup> is 0.9863; for weld hardness, it is 0.0467 and 0.9782; and for HAZ hardness, it is 0.1109 and 0.8453. Such results indicate the good ability of ensemble methods to produce highly accurate, task-specific predictions. This comparison reveals the trade-offs between the two approaches. MTL is good in scenarios where the tasks are related and the data are sparse, giving efficient training and good generalization; stacking ensembles work better in the case of accurate, independent predictions. In both cases, they show remarkable potential for improving the predictive power of welding applications, making them suitable precursors to further investigation into hybrid models that bring the best features of both approaches together.

infographic.key_insight: Stacking ensemble learning produced the most accurate predictions for UTS, weld hardness, and HAZ hardness, while the multitask neural network offered strong shared-learning performance across related welding targets.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The results help welding engineers choose between a single shared model for related outputs and task-specific ensembles when precise prediction of weld quality and mechanical properties is the priority.
method: Compared a multitask neural network (shared hidden layers with task-specific outputs) against stacking ensemble learning.
Predicted three welding response variables: UTS, weld hardness, and HAZ hardness.
Evaluated performance using RMSE and R² across the shared dataset.
infographic.evidence_signal: Stacking achieved lower RMSE and higher R² than MTNN for all three outputs, with especially strong gains for UTS and weld hardness.
infographic.watch_item: Model performance is reported on one shared dataset, so generalization to other welding processes, materials, or unseen parameter ranges should be validated before deployment.
infographic.paper_title: A Comparative Analysis of Multitask Neural Networks and Stacking Ensemble Learning for Predicting UTS, Weld Hardness, and HAZ Hardness in Welding Applications

zh-Hans.title: 用于焊接应用中UTS、焊缝硬度和HAZ硬度预测的多任务神经网络与堆叠集成学习比较分析
zh-Hans.abstract: 准确预测焊接性能指标，如极限强度（UTS）、焊缝硬度和HAZ机械硬度，对于确保焊接构件的结构完整性和服役性能至关重要。多任务学习（MTL）是指一种机器学习方法，其中一个模型被设计用于同时处理若干相互关联的任务。与为每个任务分别训练独立模型不同，MTL在任务之间共享表示，使其能够利用共同模式，同时保留任务特定差异。在本研究中，我们基于共享数据集，对两种先进的机器学习技术，即多任务神经网络（MTNN）和堆叠集成学习，用于预测这些参数进行了比较。多任务神经网络（MTNN）是多任务学习（MTL）模型的一种特定类型，它采用深度神经网络架构同时处理多个相关任务。在MTNN中，不同任务共享部分隐藏层，同时具有任务特定的输出层。这种共享表示使模型能够学习跨任务的共同模式，同时保留任务特定输出。两种方法均采用RMSE和R²进行评估，以确定其预测精度和整体有效性。结果表明，该方法具有稳健的预测能力，其RMSE分别为UTS的0.1288、焊缝硬度的0.0886以及HAZ硬度的0.1125，而R²值分别为0.6724、0.9215和0.8407。这说明它能够在相互关联的任务中具有良好的泛化能力。堆叠集成学习在单个任务的预测精度方面优于MTL：UTS的RMSE为0.0263，R²为0.9863；焊缝硬度的RMSE为0.0467，R²为0.9782；HAZ硬度的RMSE为0.1109，R²为0.8453。这些结果表明，集成方法在生成高精度、任务特定预测方面具有良好能力。该比较揭示了两种方法之间的权衡。MTL适用于任务相关且数据稀疏的场景，能够实现高效训练和良好泛化；而堆叠集成在需要高精度、独立预测的情况下表现更佳。总体而言，两者都显示出提升焊接应用预测能力的显著潜力，并可作为进一步研究混合模型的合适前驱，以结合两种方法的最佳特征。

infographic.key_insight: 堆叠集成学习对UTS、焊缝硬度和HAZ硬度给出了最准确的预测，而多任务神经网络则在相关焊接目标上提供了较强的共享学习性能。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这些结果有助于焊接工程师在相关输出的单一共享模型与任务特定集成方法之间进行选择，尤其是在精确预测焊缝质量和力学性能优先时。
method: 将多任务神经网络（共享隐藏层并具有任务特定输出）与堆叠集成学习进行了比较。
预测了三个焊接响应变量：UTS、焊缝硬度和HAZ硬度。
使用RMSE和R²在共享数据集上评估性能。
infographic.evidence_signal: 与MTNN相比，堆叠方法在三个输出上均实现了更低的RMSE和更高的R²，尤其在UTS和焊缝硬度方面提升显著。
infographic.watch_item: 模型性能仅在一个共享数据集上报告，因此在部署前，应验证其对其他焊接工艺、材料或未见参数范围的泛化能力。

title: Long-term corrosion behaviors and wear behavior of Fe-based amorphous coatings in different humidity environments
authors: Shuai Cui, Haimin Zhai, Zihan Feng, Xuqiang Li, Wensheng Li, Xiangjuan Fan
abstract: Fe-based amorphous coatings (Fe-based AMCs) were successfully prepared on Q235 carbon steel by detonation spray under different spraying parameters. The corrosion and tribology behaviors of coatings were systematically tested. The droplets show disk-like morphology with the highest circularity and expansion factor, which is crucial to reduce the defects of coatings and to form fine-lamellar-structures coatings with dense microstructure. A higher incidence of porosity defects in the coating is associated with reduced long-term corrosion resistance. Moreover, the tribo-chemical reactions between Si3N4 balls and water molecules play a significant role in wear behaviors for coating in different humidity conditions. The friction coefficient and wear rate of coatings decrease as the humidity conditions increase.

infographic.key_insight: Detonation-sprayed Fe-based amorphous coatings achieve better corrosion and wear performance when droplets spread into dense, fine-lamellar structures with fewer porosity defects.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Coating process parameters and ambient humidity strongly influence durability, making spray optimization and service-environment control important for steel protection applications.
method: Prepared Fe-based amorphous coatings on Q235 carbon steel by detonation spray under different spraying parameters.
Evaluated long-term corrosion behavior and tribological performance in different humidity environments.
Related coating microstructure, porosity, and droplet morphology to corrosion resistance and wear behavior.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports that circular disk-like droplets with high circularity and expansion factor produced denser coatings, while increased porosity reduced corrosion resistance and higher humidity lowered friction coefficient and wear rate.
infographic.watch_item: Performance depends on spray-formed microstructure and environmental humidity, so results may not transfer directly without matching process settings and service conditions.
infographic.paper_title: Long-term corrosion behaviors and wear behavior of Fe-based amorphous coatings in different humidity environments

zh-Hans.title: 不同湿度环境下铁基非晶涂层的长期腐蚀行为与磨损行为
zh-Hans.abstract: 采用爆炸喷涂在Q235碳钢上于不同喷涂参数下成功制备了铁基非晶涂层（Fe-based AMCs）。系统测试了涂层的腐蚀和摩擦学行为。液滴呈盘状形貌，具有最高的圆形度和铺展因子，这对于减少涂层缺陷并形成微结构致密的细层状涂层至关重要。涂层中更高的孔隙缺陷发生率与较差的长期耐腐蚀性相关。此外，在不同湿度条件下，Si3N4球与水分子之间的摩擦化学反应对涂层的磨损行为起着重要作用。随着湿度条件升高，涂层的摩擦系数和磨损率降低。

infographic.key_insight: 当爆炸喷涂形成致密、细层状结构且孔隙缺陷较少时，铁基非晶涂层可获得更好的耐腐蚀和耐磨性能。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 涂层工艺参数和环境湿度对耐久性影响显著，因此喷涂优化和服役环境控制对钢材防护应用很重要。
method: 在不同喷涂参数下，采用爆炸喷涂在Q235碳钢上制备铁基非晶涂层。
评估不同湿度环境中的长期腐蚀行为和摩擦学性能。
将涂层微结构、孔隙率和液滴形貌与耐腐蚀性和磨损行为联系起来。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要表明，圆盘状且圆形度和铺展因子较高的液滴形成了更致密的涂层，而孔隙率增加会降低耐腐蚀性，较高湿度会降低摩擦系数和磨损率。
infographic.watch_item: 性能取决于喷涂形成的微结构和环境湿度，因此若不匹配工艺设置和服役条件，结果可能无法直接迁移。

title: Machine learning driven prediction of mechanical and electromagnetic properties in dissimilar aluminum friction stir welded joints

infographic.engineering_relevance: The work supports faster process optimization for lightweight aluminum joining in applications where both strength and electromagnetic performance matter.
method: Builds ML models from welding/process inputs to property outputs.
Targets dissimilar aluminum friction stir welded joints.
Uses the model to forecast mechanical and electromagnetic behavior.

zh-Hans.title: 异种铝材料搅拌摩擦焊接接头中力学与电磁性能的机器学习驱动预测
zh-Hans.abstract: 收录于 OpenAlex 的 Emergent Materials 期刊论文。

infographic.key_insight: 采用机器学习预测异种铝搅拌摩擦焊工艺参数与接头力学及电磁性能之间的关系。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该研究有助于在强度和电磁性能都重要的轻质铝连接应用中，更快地进行工艺优化。
method: 基于焊接/工艺输入构建机器学习模型，并映射到性能输出。
针对异种铝搅拌摩擦焊接接头。
利用该模型预测力学和电磁行为。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要仅说明这是一篇收录于 OpenAlex 的期刊论文，因此此处未提供数据集规模、指标和验证细节。
infographic.watch_item: 在没有完整论文的情况下，尚不清楚该模型在不同合金组合、焊接条件以及未见数据集上的泛化能力如何。
